==Description==
The '''Philips x TDS Season''' was the seventh season to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. It was a season where Tower Defense Simulator partnered with [[wp:Norelco|Philips Norelco]] for the [[wp:Movember|Movember Foundation]]. As the season was made for the [[wp:Movember|Movember]] event, an annual event involving the growing of mustaches during the month of November to raise awareness of men's health issues, the skins were themed around facial hair. Additionally, some enemies spawned with facial hair because of this, with these enemies dropping the season currency. You would need to collect {{Razor|Razors}} to unlock further ranks. This season was not connected to an event.

This season released in two parts, with each part releasing four skins each. Part 1 started on the 13th of October 2022 at 05:00 UTC, while Part 2 started on the 11th of November 2022. The season ended on the 1st of December 2022.

==Season Pass==
[[File:PhilipsXTDSSeason2.png|center|500px|thumb]]

{{Razor|Razors}} were collected by killing enemies that spawn with facial hair. All naturally spawned enemies could randomly spawn with facial hair. The facial hair chosen was also random. These enemies would drop between one and three {{Razor|Razors}} when killed, which would have to be collected by walking up to them. The amount of {{Razor|Razors}} gotten could not be increased by [[Modifiers]].

In total, it would take {{Razor|3,000 Razors}} or {{Robux|3,430}} to complete the season pass.

==Trivia==
*The '''Philips x TDS Season''' is the first season that is partnered to a real-life company.
*The '''Philips x TDS Season''' is the first season to have droppable currency required for progression, unlike all other seasons where all event currency can be earned solely by completing matches.
*Before the second part of the '''Philips x TDS Season''' released, the next skins could be seen as rewards, though only their sillhouettes. They were also unobtainable.
**All of these skins would later be added except for the fifth skin, which the decal for the skin icon referred to as ''Mall Guard''. When the second part of the season released, it was replaced by the {{Color|Philips|Baseball}} [[Warden]].
***Since the icon for the ''Mall Guard'' skin could be seen holding a pistol, it was most likely a skin for a pistol wielding tower, like the [[Commander]] or [[Crook Boss]].
*Prior to the release of this season, the amount of {{Razor|Razors}} required to reach ranks was increased on the 10th of October 2022, the same day the season was originally meant to start. The total {{Razor|Razors}} required for the the ranks added in part 1 rank were:
**Rank 1 - {{Razor|100}}
**Rank 2 - {{Razor|275}}
**Rank 3 - {{Razor|350}}
**Rank 4 - {{Razor|500}}
**Similarly, shortly after the release of '''Philips x TDS Season's''' part 2, the amount of {{Razor|Razors}} required to reach ranks was decreased. The total {{Razor|Razors}} required for the ranks added in part 2 were:
***Rank 5 - {{Razor|1,400}}
***Rank 6 - {{Razor|1,800}}
***Rank 7 - {{Razor|2,600}}
***Rank 8 - {{Razor|3,300}}
***Rank 9 - {{Razor|4,000}}
*As of the [[v1.11.0|Krampus' Revenge Update]], all of the skins have returned in either the [[Premium Crate]] or the [[Deluxe Crate]].
